# Bridlewise

> Bridlewise is an experimental, local-first coding cockpit. A run is a causal
> record: model turns, governed tool calls, file effects, checks, findings, and
> typed refusals. The product is a developer preview, pre-admission
> (`harnessReady: false`), not production-ready, and not for sensitive,
> proprietary, regulated, or production code.

This file is a curated map for language models and agents. It is not a
substitute for the repository or the security policy. The source and the
tests are the authority.

## The one-page orientation

- [Landing page](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/): the concept,
  the three doors, and the warning.
- [Run record](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/run/): an
  illustrative, synthetic causal record. It is not a live model run.
- [Policy lab](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/policy-lab/): an
  illustrative governance console. Toggling a switch does not admit a real
  capability.
- [Architecture](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/architecture/):
  cockpit, loopback server, engine, guardian, timeline, and memory.
- [Security and limits](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/security/):
  the safety floor, the confinement model, and what is not defended.
- [Glossary](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/glossary/): the
  vocabulary the product uses precisely.
- [Evidence](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/evidence/): what can
  be verified and what cannot.
- [Known issues](https://llm-4-people.github.io/bridlewise/known-issues/):
  current gaps, without marketing.

## Repository facts

- Product: https://github.com/LLM-4-People/bridlewise
- Development floor: https://github.com/LLM-4-People/bridlewise-testing
- Release: https://github.com/LLM-4-People/bridlewise/releases/tag/v0.0.2-preview
- License: AGPL-3.0-only for both repositories.
- Runtime: Node.js >=24.18.0 <25.0.0. Linux-first; Landlock confinement is
  Linux-only. The cockpit server binds loopback by default.
- The public smoke suite is reproducible from a fresh clone; the full
  corpus-backed development-floor suite is not, because the 4.1 GB corpus is
  not published.

## What not to infer

- A green CI badge is not a security audit.
- A recorded run is not a proof that every effect was benign.
- A successful check is not a guarantee that the check was sufficient.
- An illustrative UI is not a connected engine.
- A public preview is not a production support commitment.
